planComparison: Actual production change is about +417/-159 lines against the 900-line estimate (180 added in existing files, 237 in three new files: the page hero, the day timeline and the search shortcut). Both subsections, their boundary and all ten frozen acceptance items are delivered; the estimate was high because the public pages replaced existing markup and reused the shared page hero, and the desk changes were small components. Deliberate differences, all recorded in STATUS and DECISIONS: only two severity words (Urgent, Soon) because the data has two levels; In progress added to the timeline words; every visit drawn one hour because Today does not load each visit's recorded length (reading it is held for the owner's approval); the Actual tag added beside the existing Estimate tag because Today has no money tiles of its own. Gate: the owner's acceptance of the bolder look stays open.
newEngineering: Page hero; pricing, how-it-works, service-area, contact, launch and city recomposition; day timeline with pure placement, Colorado minute-of-day helper; severity stripe and word; Actual tag; search shortcut; portal evergreen help card; hero, timeline and component unit tests; two browser specs; docs.
relatedWorkDecision: V-3 (public pages) and V-4 (desk and portal) ship together because the owner asked for larger chunks and a bolder look in one step; their risks are independent and each has its own tests, and nothing reads new data.
